name: preflight
description: Check. Fix. Ship. Scan GitHub repos against org standards and open fix PRs.

preflight.model.default.description: Model used for AI checks and fixes. Only models your Copilot plan offers can be selected.

preflight.sonar.url.markdownDescription: Base URL of your self-hosted SonarQube server, e.g. `https://sonar.example.com`. Empty (default) means no SonarQube: coverage is estimated from the code. Store the token with **Preflight: Set Sonar Token**.

preflight.coverage.threshold.markdownDescription: Target test coverage in percent (`0`-`100`, default `80`). With SonarQube connected this is measured line coverage. Without it, coverage is estimated as the share of source files that have a test file named after them. The Coverage PR writes enough tests to reach this value.

preflight.coverage.maxFiles.markdownDescription:
Most source files one Coverage PR writes tests for.

- `0` (default): no limit. Preflight writes tests for exactly as many files as the threshold needs.
- Any other number: at most that many files per PR, for smaller PRs over several runs. The PR notes say if coverage is still below the threshold.

preflight.branch.template.markdownDescription: Template for PR branch names. Placeholders: `{user}`, `{repo}`, `{check-or-category}`, `{date}`, `{shortid}`, `{type}` (`fixes` or `coverage`).

preflight.branch.pattern.markdownDescription: Optional regular expression every generated or edited branch name must match, e.g. `^(feature|chore)/[a-z0-9._-]+$`. Empty (default) means only git's own naming rules apply.

preflight.staleBranchDays.markdownDescription: A branch with no commits for this many days counts as stale (default `90`).

preflight.license.allow.markdownDescription: SPDX licence IDs dependencies may use. Empty (default) means no allow list: any licence not on the deny list passes.

preflight.license.deny.markdownDescription: SPDX licence IDs that always fail the licence compliance check. Default: AGPL and SSPL.
